Name: Just Sleep In
Author: 9Rifleman
Description:
A simple, RP friendly alarm clock mode. Allows players to sleep past 6AM, up to 12PM. Setting up the alarm is done through simple pop-ups during the day. Now you can choose if you want to be an early bird or take you beauty nap.

[b]Important note: [/b] this mod is currently best used for role-play. Right now it may affect NPC pathing and NPCs may not be at their given coordinates at a given time - this is something I am trying to study and hopefully add later on. If the path of an NPC is broken, just go to sleep(ideally until 6 or 7 tops) and it'll fix itself.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
As it's just a simple event, it should be compatible with almost everything. Source code: [url=https://github.com/9Rifleman/JustSleepIn]9Rifleman/JustSleepIn: Simple RP friendly Stardew Valley alarm clock mode (github.com)[/url]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[b][u]1.2.1[/u][/b]

-[b] option to set permanent wake up time [/b]added, this mode disables other features of this mod. Press [b]LCtrl[/b] + [b]~ [/b]to enable/disable
- added icons to banner messages
- fixed a bug that could cause incorrect text to show in pop-ups. 

[b][u]1.2.0[/u][/b]

- Tilde now disables or enables the pop-ups(good if you just want the clock feature, but not the reminders)
- Option to manually set time moved to [b]V[/b](or [b]Xbox button[/b])
- Added a 'tutorial' letter, it should be in your mailbox the next morning after you go to sleep for the first time after loading this mod

[u][b]1.1.1[/b][/u]

- Option to manually set the time added. It can be invoked at any time by [b]pressing [/b]the [b]Tilde[/b] key(below Esc) on keyboard or [b]Left Stick[/b] on a gamepad. 

[u][b]1.1.0[/b][/u][b] [/b]

- Popup system reworked. Now it's based around the time of sunset(changes with season). You get a reminder to set up alarm if you are at your house within 2 hours before twilight and can now choose to be reminded again later. Next reminder you get again only at your house between teilight and 10PM, this one you can postpone as well. Finally, if nothing has been chosen yet, you get a final popup at 10PM sharp, no matter where you are, and this time you need to choose. The choices of time have not changed. The old version is still available in Files.

[b][u]1.0.1[/u] [/b]

- Added more options going up to 12PM

[u][b]1.0.0[/b] [/u]

- The initial release
